name: Ponferrada to Villafranca del Bierzo
notes: Villafranca del Bierzo: the place=village node is used; Nominatim lists the municipality relation first, with a centroid 10 km to the north (42.69526,-6.79307) that must not be used. Columbrianos lies 2.4 km off the straight line (north-west of Ponferrada) but is on the Camino. Pieros lies between Cacabelos and Villafranca. Variant (general knowledge, not looked up): a quieter alternative between Cacabelos and Villafranca runs through the vineyards via Valtuille de Abajo. Fuentes Nuevas (between Columbrianos and Camponaraya) is on the Camino but was not looked up.
